QuestInfo.name: The Puppet
QuestInfo.0: #p2400000# was flustered by the duo's report of monsters in the Dusk Temple. They would need to talk to her more to figure out what was going wrong.
QuestInfo.1: #p2400000# feared there was some sort of interference in time and space. She suggested they attempt to #bactivate the Goddess Teardrops again#k. If it failed this time...
QuestInfo.2: #p2400005# and #p2400006#'s attempt to activate the Goddess Teardrops failed again, but this time they found themselves face to face with Will! #p2470018# was there too, bound by evil magic. Will told them what he had done, separating them into two beings, and corrupting one. He claimed that only one of them would survive, but which one?

0.0: I don't know what caused that bizarre anomaly, but we must try, try again! I only hope it was some form of interference in time and space preventing you from awakening your true powers...
0.1: But let's not worry yet. It could have just been a hiccup! #bUse the Goddess Teardrops#k again. If things go wrong again, we shall reassess, and find another way.
